name: conference-video-cutter
description: Bilingual, cloud-first and provider-neutral conference video review and cutting tools for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review transcripts and cut verified speaker clips.
interface.longDescription: A bilingual Codex workflow for provider-neutral transcript review, speaker and Q&A boundaries, privacy-aware preflight, and verified FFmpeg exports. Cloud transcription is explicit; local ASR is optional.
defaultPrompt: Review this conference transcript and build speaker clips.
Check speaker names and Q&A boundaries against the video.
Run a privacy-safe preflight before processing this recording.
